description: Shared preset of the teams' repositories, run from gear-ops/IaC's renovate.yaml: non-major updates come as one PR on Monday 00:00-07:59 UTC, a major waits for its checkbox in the Dependency Dashboard, and a fix for a vulnerability GitHub or OSV reports gets its own PR labelled security at once.

A new digest of a Dockerfile's base image merges itself without waiting for checks, since the teams' repositories run none on a pull request: build-deploy builds and scans the merged commit before it deploys, so a base that breaks the build stops there, and the image is rebuilt on a fresh base every week.

packageRules.description: An npm release waits a week: a hijacked or broken release is usually pulled within days
Majors wait for their checkbox in the Dependency Dashboard
A base image's new digest under the same tag changes no version: one PR per repository, merged by Renovate itself with no check to wait for; the build after the merge stops a broken one before deploy
